banner.title: E whakamana ana mātou i tō matatapu
banner.text: Ka whakamahi mātou i ngā cookie me ngā hangarau pēnei. Ka whakahaere ngā cookie e hiahiatia ana i te pae. Mā tō whakaaetanga, ka whakamahi hoki mātou i ngā cookie kōwhiri mō ngā āhuatanga, ngā tātaritanga me te mākete. Ka taea e koe te whakaae ki te katoa, te whakaparahako ki te katoa, te kōwhiri rānei ia kāwai, ā, te huri i tō whakaaro i ngā wā katoa.

preferences.title: Ngā kōwhiringa cookie
preferences.text: Kōwhiria ngā kāwai kōwhiri e whakaaetia ana e koe. Kāore e taea te whakaweto i ngā cookie e hiahiatia ana nā te mea kāore te pae e mahi mēnā kāore ērā.
preferences.alwaysActive: Kei te mahi i ngā wā katoa

necessary.title: E hiahiatia ana
necessary.description: E hiahiatia ana mō ngā mahi taketake pēnei i te haumarutanga, te tohatoha kawenga me te maumahara ki tēnei kōwhiringa whakaaetanga.

functional.title: Mahi
functional.description: Ka maumahara ki ngā kōwhiringa pēnei i te reo, te rohe rānei, ā, ka whakahohe i ngā āhuatanga tāmau.

analytics.title: Tātaritanga
analytics.description: Ka āwhina i a mātou ki te mārama ki te whakamahinga o te pae kia pai ake ai.

marketing.title: Mākete
marketing.description: Ka whakamahia hei ine me te whakatau i ngā panuku pānui puta noa i ngā pae paetukutuku.

blockedContent: Kua puru tēnei ihirangi kia tae ki te wā e whakaaetia ai e koe te kāwai "{category}".
